meaning:
ἔμ-πορος, -ου, ὁ
(πόρος, a journey), [in LXX chiefly for סָחַר, רָכַל ;]
1. a passenger on shipboard, one on a journey.
2. a merchant: Mat.13:45, Rev.18:3, 11 18:15, 23.†
(AS)
